name: Spiritual creatures

variantInfo.name: Spiritual ranger
notes: Combat levels are 118 (Zamorak), 122 (Saradomin), 115 (Bandos), 127 (Armadyl), and 158 (Zaros).
Slayer XP values are 106, 106, 131, 120, and 110 respectively.
Spiritual rangers require 63 Slayer to kill.
The Zarosian variant can occasionally launch an arrow into the air.
If the Zarosian arrow is not dodged it deals heavy damage, disable overhead protection prayers, and binds the player for a few seconds.

variantInfo.name: Spiritual warrior
notes: Combat levels are 115 (Zamorak), 125 (Saradomin), 134 (Bandos), 123 (Armadyl), and 158 (Zaros).
Slayer XP values are 110, 110, 135, 98, and 105 respectively.
Spiritual warriors require 68 Slayer to kill.
The Zarosian variant periodically unleashes smoke clouds in an X formation around the player.
Failing to move from the Zarosian smoke-cloud special attack can deal up to 40 damage.

variantInfo.name: Spiritual mage
notes: Combat levels are 121 (Zamorak), 120 (Saradomin), 121 (Bandos), 123 (Armadyl), and 182 (Zaros).
Slayer XP values are 75, 85, 106, 75, and 137.5 respectively.
Spiritual mages require 83 Slayer to kill and are the only Spiritual creatures that drop dragon boots.
The Zamorakian variant's Flames of Zamorak drains Magic levels if it successfully hits and damages the player.
The Zarosian variant uses Ancient Magicks: smoke poisons, shadow drains Attack, blood heals the mage, and ice freezes the player.
The Zarosian Ancient Magicks secondary effects occur on successful hits even if the damage would be blocked by prayer.

taskNotes: Spiritual creatures require Death Plateau, 80 combat, and either 60 Strength or 60 Agility before assignment.
Spiritual rangers require 63 Slayer, Spiritual warriors require 68 Slayer, and Spiritual mages require 83 Slayer.
Spiritual mages are the only Spiritual creatures that drop dragon boots.
Spiritual creatures are only found in the God Wars Dungeon and Wilderness God Wars Dungeon.
Each god's followers are aggressive unless the player wears a god-affiliated item aligned to that god; wearing the item makes them tolerant.
God item protection is effectively required because the dungeons are multicombat and contain many aggressive monsters.
In the main God Wars Dungeon, bring at least one Zamorak-affiliated item and usually one Saradomin-affiliated item.
Bandos and Armadyl spiritual creatures are rarely killed.
In the Ancient Prison, only a Zaros-affiliated item is required inside, but Saradomin and Zamorak items are recommended for the route to the entrance.
In the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon, bring one Armadyl or Bandos item depending on entrance, one Saradomin item, and one Zamorak item.
Armadyl spiritual creatures require 70 Ranged and a crossbow that can fire a mithril grapple, though they can be attacked with melee weapons unlike Aviansie.
Bandos spiritual creatures require 70 Strength and a hammer.
Zamorak spiritual creatures require 70 Hitpoints; entering Zamorak's Fortress drains all prayer points.
Zaros spiritual creatures require The Frozen Door miniquest and 70 Strength, Hitpoints, Ranged, and Agility.
Many players block Spiritual creatures because they are neither cannonable nor AFK'able, have low experience rates, and have poor drops compared to similar Slayer monsters.
Ironman players may unblock the task at 83 Slayer to obtain dragon boots.
The task page recommends Spiritual rangers - skip or block.
The task page recommends Spiritual warriors - kill in Zamorak's Fortress if killing them at all.
The task page recommends Spiritual mages - kill in Zamorak's Fortress or Ancient Prison.
recommendedMethod: Skip or block Spiritual rangers. If killing the task, use Zamorak's Fortress for Spiritual warriors or Zamorak's Fortress/Ancient Prison for Spiritual mages, wearing the relevant god items for tolerance. Ironman accounts may prefer Spiritual mages at 83 Slayer for dragon boots.
